fields.start, end: predicted step span in seconds of the trimmed video (Module B)
fields.step_id, step: predicted step (Module A); EXTRA is an off-script step and has no instruction
fields.classification: execution class (Module C); EXTRA steps are ADDITION
fields.is_error: classification is not CORRECT; this is the error label EDA and binary F1 score, so CORRECTION counts as an error
fields.decided_at: video time of the Module A poll that triggered this step
fields.clip: clip Module A and Module B saw: the cursor (previous step's end) to decided_at
fields.reasoning: Module C's explanation, null for EXTRA steps
